title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register as a student or client with valid inputs, receives a verification email, and can login.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Fill in required fields with valid data and select role (student or client)
Submit the registration form
Registration is successful and a verification email is sent
Verify email via link received
Proceed to login page and enter the registered credentials
Submit login form
User is logged in and JWT token is received

title: User Registration with Invalid Data
description: Verify registration fails with missing or invalid input fields (e.g., email format, password constraints).

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Fill registration form with invalid email and weak password
Submit the registration form
Appropriate validation error messages are displayed and registration is blocked

title: Password Reset Flow
description: Verify that a user can request password reset, receive an email with reset link, and successfully reset password.

steps.description: Navigate to Forgot Password page
Enter registered email and submit
Password reset email with valid link is sent
Navigate to reset password page via link
Enter and confirm new valid password
Submit the reset form
Password is updated and user can login with new password

title: Student Freelancer Profile Creation and Editing
description: Verify that verified student freelancers can create and update their profile including skills, portfolio, bio, and social links.

steps.description: Login as a verified student freelancer
Navigate to profile creation/edit page
Fill in profile details: add skills, upload portfolio items, enter bio and social links
Submit profile form
Profile data is saved and displayed correctly on the profile page
Edit some profile fields and submit updates
Profile updates are persisted and displayed correctly

title: Service Listing Creation and Validation
description: Verify that student freelancers can create paid service listings with proper validations including category selection and pricing above zero.

steps.description: Login as a verified student freelancer
Navigate to create service page
Enter valid service title, description, select category, upload images/portfolio, set a positive price
Submit the service listing
Service is created and visible in marketplace
Attempt service creation with zero or negative price
Validation error prevents listing creation

title: Browse and Search Service Marketplace by Category
description: Verify clients and students can browse service marketplace, filter by category, search keywords, and view service details.

steps.description: Login as any user
Navigate to services marketplace page
Filter services by selected category
Marketplace displays only services in selected category
Perform a keyword search in service marketplace
Search results are relevant and displayed properly
Click a service listing to view detailed page
Service detail page shows correct info including pricing, description, and freelancer profile

title: Job Posting and Application Management
description: Verify clients can post jobs with details and students can apply. Applications are manageable and visible to both parties.

steps.description: Login as client user
Navigate to create job page
Enter job title, description, category, budget, and submission deadline
Submit job posting
Job is listed on job board and visible to student users
Login as student user
Navigate to job listings
Select a job and submit an application with cover letter
Application is recorded and visible to client
Client reviews applications and selects candidate
Application status updates and notifications sent properly

title: Order Creation and Status Workflow
description: Verify clients can place orders on services with payment before acceptance, and orders progress through statuses from acceptance, delivery submission, to completion.

steps.description: Login as client
Browse a paid service and place an order
Complete payment and confirm order
Order is created with status 'Pending Acceptance'
Freelancer logs in and accepts the order
Order status updates to 'In Progress'
Freelancer submits delivery work through order management system
Client receives notification of delivery submission
Client reviews delivery and approves or requests revision
Order status updates accordingly to 'Completed' or 'Revisions Requested'

title: Payment Wallet and Withdrawal Process
description: Verify wallet balance updates after payments and commissions, and withdrawal requests by freelancers are handled with admin approval.

steps.description: Login as freelancer
Check initial wallet balance
Complete service order and receive payment
Wallet balance reflects payment minus platform commission
Request withdrawal of available balance
Withdrawal request is recorded and pending admin approval
Admin logs in and reviews withdrawal requests
Admin approves a withdrawal
Wallet balance is decremented and withdrawal marked as completed
Attempt withdrawal exceeding wallet balance
Withdrawal request is rejected with appropriate error

title: Real-Time Messaging Functionality
description: Verify users can send and receive real-time messages, and message statuses (delivered, read) update correctly.

steps.description: Login as client user in one browser/session
Login as freelancer user in another browser/session
Client sends message to freelancer
Freelancer receives the message instantly
Freelancer reads message
Client sees message read status
Freelancer replies and client receives it in real-time
Message delivery and read receipts function correctly

title: Review and Rating Submission After Order Completion
description: Verify clients can submit reviews and star ratings only after order completion, with anti-spam measures to prevent multiple submissions.

steps.description: Complete an order as client
Navigate to review submission page for the completed order
Submit star rating and text review
Review is saved and displayed on freelancer profile
Attempt to submit a second review for the same order
Second review is blocked by anti-spam control
Attempt to submit review before order completion
Review submission is disallowed and error shown

title: Notification System for Orders and Messages
description: Verify that notifications are generated for order status updates and new messages with accurate read/unread states and persistence.

steps.description: Login as client and place order
Login as freelancer and accept order
Client receives notification about order acceptance
Client sends a message to freelancer
Freelancer receives a notification for the new message
User views notification panel and marks notifications as read
Notifications read/unread status updates and persists across sessions

title: Personalized Dashboard Data Accuracy
description: Verify that dashboards for students and clients accurately reflect active orders, engagements, services, jobs, and relevant analytics in real-time.

steps.description: Login as student
Dashboard shows active orders, services listed, application statuses, and personal analytics accurately
Login as client
Dashboard shows posted jobs, active orders, engagements, and analytics accurately
Place new orders, accept jobs, create services
Dashboard updates reflect changes in less than 5 seconds

title: Admin Panel - User and Service Moderation
description: Verify admin users can view, search, and moderate user accounts and service listings, including approving or suspending users and services.

steps.description: Login as admin user
Navigate to user management section
Search users by email, name, or role
User list is correctly filtered and displayed
Select a user and perform moderation actions (suspend, reactivate)
User status updates correctly and moderation actions are logged
Navigate to service management section
Approve, edit, or remove service listings
Service status reflects moderation changes and listings update accordingly

title: Role-Based Access Control and Route Protection
description: Verify that navigation routes and pages are accessible only to appropriate roles and that unauthorized access redirects with proper messages.

steps.description: Login as client user
Attempt to navigate to admin panel URL directly
Access is denied and user is redirected to unauthorized or login page
Login as student freelancer
Navigate to job posting creation page
Access is denied since only clients can post jobs
Logout and attempt to access any protected page
User is redirected to login page for authentication

title: API Endpoint Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify that API endpoints respond with meaningful error messages for invalid inputs and unauthorized requests and handle edge cases gracefully.

steps.description: Send API request to create service with missing required fields
API returns 400 status with validation error details
Send API request to access order details without valid JWT token
API returns 401 Unauthorized status with error message
Send malformed JWT token in API request header
API returns 401 Unauthorized due to invalid token
Access resource with valid JWT token but insufficient role permission
API returns 403 Forbidden response

title: Responsive UI/UX on Desktop and Mobile
description: Verify that all pages including landing page, dashboards, and core features render correctly on multiple devices and maintain corporate styling standards.

steps.description: Open platform landing page on desktop browser
Page shows features and value propositions with corporate styling and no visual defects
Repeat on mobile devices with various screen sizes
Layout adjusts responsively, navigation is usable, and content is legible
Navigate through dashboard, order pages, messaging on mobile
All UI elements are functional without broken layout or overlaps

title: Security: Password Hashing and JWT Token Storage
description: Verify passwords are hashed with Bcryptjs before storage and JWT tokens expire correctly with secure storage on the client side.

steps.description: Register new user with password
Password stored in database is hashed and not plaintext
Login and receive JWT token
Token contains expiry date and is stored securely (e.g., httpOnly cookie or secure storage)
Wait for token expiry and attempt to use expired token for API
Request is rejected with unauthorized error
